[u]Information:[/u]

Adds an overlay to the left side of your window which tracks the npc relations you have chosen in the config file.


[u]List of Npc names:[/u]

[url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Villagers]http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Villagers[/url]



[b]If you use the ExperienceBar mod change the "RenderOffSetY" in the config to 240![/b]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/509/?]http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/509/?[/url]

[u]
Explanation:[/u]

Leah - 66 of 250 - 3 hearts - 2 of 2

[list]
[*]Leah = name of npc
[*]66 of 250   = amount needed to get the next heart
[*]3 hearts     = current hearts
[*]2 of 2 = gifts this week
[/list]

[u]How to change the toggle key - >V<

[/u]Locate the key you want, eg. the key [b]Z[/b].
Go to the link below and search for it, [b]Z[/b] would be [b]90.
[/b]Locate the config and change the current [b]86 [/b]to and [b]90 [/b]and restart the game.


[url=https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/0z084th3(v=vs.90).aspx#Anchor_1]https://msdn.microsoft.com/en-us/library/0z084th3(v=vs.90).aspx#Anchor_1[/url]


[b]Configuration:[/b]

[list]
[*]"RenderOffSetY": 0,     Offset in vertical
[/list]
[list]
[*]"RenderOffSetX": 0,       Offset in horizontal
[/list]
[list]
[*]"FlipNpcList": false,      Mirrors the list to the right side
[/list]
[list]
[*]"RenderGifting": true,    Show how much gifts are left for the week
[*]"ShortendHud": false, Full hud or minimized
[/list]
[list]
[*]"NpcList": [ Which npc should be tracked
[*]"Maru",
[*]"Penny"
[*]  ],
[/list]
[list]
[*]"ShowStatus": 86   The toggle key, look above how to change it.
[/list]

[u]Requires SMAPI![/u]

[url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-stardew-modding-api.108375/]http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/smapi-stardew-modding-api.108375/[/url]
